digest.component_or_area: llm core module (runner.py, structured.py, capabilities.py, providers.py)
propositions: extra_tools field is live (set by completion_recovery.py:469,665 and threaded through runs.py) but documented with a stale 'always None in practice' comment that must be corrected in place

Three sites assert Anthropic 400s on extended-thinking + native-output-constraint, conflicting with structured.py:228-238 claiming that rationale is stale; the real gate is native_structured_output and (not thinking or native_output_with_thinking)

capabilities.py:166-198 is a structurally complete ADR (web-search security posture, three numbered bounds, accepted limitations) that must be relocated to a new ADR >=0063, not kept as an inline comment
providers.py:3-16 duplicates ADR 0059 §1 verbatim (including file:line citations) and should be collapsed to a one-line citation

runner.py is at C901 ceiling (371-line method) and can recover ~45 lines by removing redundant/stale prose without splitting; measured recovery target is ~46 net comment/docstring lines across the module
